decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a high-quality, versatile backpack, but the search results were cluttered with unrelated camping gear like stoves, coffee pots, and solar lanterns. Within the actual backpacks shown, most were either too specialized (disc golf or hydration packs) or appeared to be budget-oriented packable bags. The KAUKKO schoolbag had some durability concerns in the reviews, with a user reporting a strap breaking after 4 months. Ultimately, nothing in this selection met my criteria for a primary, durable backpack, so I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
